layers.label: Mineral occurrences (2023 map)
layers.description: Mineral Resources Map of Nigeria (2023): occurrence points hand-picked at every mineral symbol on the sheet. Each point is re-centered on its raster symbol where a one-to-one template match was certain; points in ambiguous symbol clusters keep their as-digitized position. match_class records which case applied.

layers.label: General (picture)
layers.description: General (small-scale) geology of Nigeria digitised from general-geology-map-of-nigeria.png (615x715 px, ~2.5 km/px) into 8 colour classes of its legend. Quaternary alluvium and Mesozoic sediments share one pale-yellow legend colour on the picture and cannot be separated by colour, so they are ONE class here (the detailed 2011 geology layer geology_units_map2011_pg separates them). Rivers, dotted lines and place markers on the sheet are absorbed into the surrounding class. Georeferenced by outline fit to the geology land mask. Compare with the detailed layer geology_units_map2011_pg for accuracy.

layers.label: General code (picture)
layers.description: General geology class code (1-8, order of geology_general_picture_pg). Categorical single band; see meta_picture_value_legend_tbl. Derived by rasterising the vector layer geology_general_picture_pg at 0.005 deg. EPSG:4326.

layers.label: Surficial (USGS)
layers.description: Surficial geology of Nigeria from the supplied USGS shapefile geo7_2ag (Persits et al., Geology, Oil and Gas Fields, and Geologic Provinces of Africa, OFR 97-470-A, 2002; small scale, Africa-wide). Clipped to the GADM national outline and dissolved by unit (glg_code), on a 0.002 deg (about 220 m) grid. Original polygon ids, area and perimeter columns dropped; area_km2 recomputed. EPSG:4326. Codes Kl, H2O and SEA are labelled by us (they are missing from the metadata list of the source).

layers.label: Surficial code (USGS)
layers.description: Single-band geology unit code of the USGS surficial geology (geology_surficial_usgs_pg), 1..n in alphabetical order of glg_code; see geology_surficial_usgs_legend_tbl. Rasterised at 0.005 deg, outside Nigeria = NoData. EPSG:4326.
